Hi Samantha / Mark —

Thanks again for the time earlier today. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we can keep Procurement and Legal moving: 

Key stakeholders we captured (please correct me if I missed anyone):
- Economic buyer: Samantha Lee (VP Product) — driving budget & timeline
- Procurement lead: Mark Tobias — contract & T&Cs
- Security/Compliance reviewer: Mark + Legal team (unspecified)
- Engineering/PO: internal platform team (you mentioned a manager will join next call)

Top decision criteria you highlighted:
- Data residency & retention controls (90–365 day retention options)
- SOC 2 Type II evidence and recent pen-test summary
- Audit log availability (format + sample) and integration with your SIEM
- Predictable cost/throughput (reserved/dedicated options)

Immediate ask / promise from Redwood:
1) I will share a concise evidence packet covering: SOC 2 summary, pen-test highlights, a small sample of audit log output, and our data retention/deletion answers. (Attachments below; will also upload to a secure share.)
2) Rishi will provide brief notes on encryption, audit log format, and retention enforcement.
3) Schedule a focused 30-min follow-up with Procurement + Security + Econ buyer to confirm SOW/terms — proposed window Wed 5/20 10:00–10:30am ET.

Attachments (stubs): SOC2-Redwood-summary-20260518.pdf; pen-test-highlights-202604.pdf; audit-logs-sample.txt; data-retention-answers-brief.docx

If that all sounds right, mark OK and we'll get the secure share and calendar invite out.

Best,
Ben

Thanks Ben — this is helpful and aligns with what I heard on our side. A couple of clarifications/asks from Procurement & Security: 

- Can you confirm the SOC 2 is Type II and includes the controls around encryption-at-rest and key management? Procurement will want the report PDF plus a short controls mapping doc.
- We need a pen-test summary (not full report) that lists scope and whether any high-risk findings were remediated.
- Audit log sample should include timestamps, user identifiers, event types, and a note on retention export format (CSV/JSON).
- Our legal team will request a data deletion SLA and confirmation on data retention options (90/180/365).

Please include Mark (procurement) on the follow-up threads. He'll be the one to coordinate the PO and contracting cadence. Proposed follow-up: Wed 5/20 at 10:00am ET works for me.

One more piece — do you have a HubSpot link or portal where we can reference the SOW/deal details?

Samantha

On Mon, May 18, 2026 at 5:04 PM Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@novarahealth.com> wrote:
> Thanks Ben — this is helpful and aligns with what I heard on our side. A couple of clarifications/asks from Procurement & Security:

Hi Samantha / Mark — quick technical notes inline below and attached: 

- SOC 2: Yes, Type II (period: 2025-01 to 2025-12). We will provide the SOC 2 report PDF and a one-page control mapping table that highlights encryption, access controls, and change management. (Attachment: SOC2-Redwood-summary-20260518.pdf)
- Encryption: AES-256 at rest, TLS 1.2+ in transit. Keys managed via customer-configurable KMS integrations (AWS KMS, GCP KMS).
- Pen-test: Third-party pen test completed 2026-04, no critical findings; summary attached. (pen-test-highlights-202604.pdf)
- Audit logs: We can export logs in JSON or CSV. Sample attached (audit-logs-sample.txt) — it includes timestamp, user_id (hashed), event_type, model_id, request_id. Retention configuration: per-customer default 90 days, configurable to 180 or 365 on Dedicated/Private plans.
- Data deletion: We offer immediate logical deletion of customer data on request, with physical deletion dependent on the storage provider's SLA (we document timelines). We'll provide a short data-retention-answers brief for Legal.

I'll upload a sanitized set of log samples to the secure share and include a read-only link below. If you need a SIEM ingestion demo (Splunk/Datadog), we can schedule a 20-min tech call.

Rishi
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
